articles.title: Curiosity Rover Spots Mysterious Cliffs Ahead on Mars
articles.summary: Curiosity's new Mars panorama shows wind-carved cliffs that scientists hope to study up close in 2027.

articles.title: Scientists Find an Eyeless Snail Living in a Dark Chinese Cave
articles.summary: A new eyeless, see-through snail found in a high Chinese cave is the country's first known freshwater cave snail.

articles.title: A $10 Light Sensor Could Bring Lab Tests to Your Wrist
articles.summary: Cambridge researchers built a $10 light sensor that measures as precisely as large lab machines.
